summary: PRIORITY BUG VERIFICATION COMPLETE: Android Chrome rendering bug fix verified + all invalid test APIs fixed. Fixed 8 test cases in advanced.spec.ts (EnemySystem.spawn returns boolean, round 10 signal setup, desktop button selector). verified_fixes.bug: Android Chrome combat rendering showed color stripes/blurry graphics (user: 'todo se ve como rayas de colores ... todo borroso todo feo')
verified_fixes.root_cause: Canvas2D desynchronized:true caused front-buffer tearing on Android scanout - clear and individual draw calls shown as torn stripes during combat painting
fix_applied: Offscreen buffer composition: all world/actors/VFX composed on persistent buffer, front canvas only one drawImage per completed render
Native DPR capped at 2 for presentation (line 38)
Internal resolution uses ONE SCALE for both dimensions - old independent minwidth240 caused aspect distortion (line 29)
